mapping_basis: The paper's name DNp11 is a MANC/Namiki type name in type_list.csv mapping to exactly one MANC type.
notes: Ph.D. dissertation (Peek 2018, Card lab). Only the repository abstract was readable: the 71 MB full-text PDF exceeded the fetch size limit. Abstract says activation used 'cell type-specific lines' but names no line, effector or preparation; preparation kept as given ('other'). Jump = single movement, so legs coded 'no' per PROTOCOL section 3.
quote: DNp11 activation generated forward jumps, whereas DNp02 and DNp04 co-activation induced backwards jumps.
stimulation: optogenetic activation; parameters not stated in abstract
title: Control of Escape Behavior by Descending Neurons in Drosophila Melanogaster
